newsitem.title: USA: Coleman holding co plans big junk bond deal-source.
newsitem.headline: Coleman holding co plans big junk bond deal-source.

text.p: A new holding company of Coleman Co Inc is expected to issue about $470 million zero coupon bonds to refinance outstanding zero coupon debt and convertible notes as early as next week, sources said.
Bear, Stearns & Co Inc will act as lead underwriter for the deal, the sources added.

While the final structure of the deal has yet to be determined, sources said the deal was expected to consist of two tranches of four-year zero coupon notes. Tranches will be distinguished by the amount of collateral backing the bonds.
The notes will be backed by 44.1 million shares of Coleman owned by MacAndrews & Forbes.
A MacAndrews & Forbes spokesman was unavailable for comment.
